Description: Equal weights (25%) across all 4 pillars; equal within-pillar weights.
Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) calibrated to state guidelines (Climate 35%, Ag 30%, Runoff 20%, Infiltration 15%).
Objective Shannon Entropy weights derived from information dispersion contrast across basins.
Subsurface Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR): prioritizes permeable sandy strata, rolling relief, and acute drought frequency.
Surface Water Harvesting (SWH): prioritizes impermeable vertisols (low seepage), high runoff depth, and cropland density.
AHP weighting evaluated exclusively on the 402 full-coverage (>=90%) catchments to eliminate border edge-effects.
AHP model with 1st-99th percentile winsorized normalization to mitigate coastal precipitation outliers.
